welcome: 👋 Welcome to my website, visitor. Check the campfire, the table, or the beds to make an action...
motivation: I'm a sofware developer engineer into the world of technology since I was 6 years old! In the aim of getting behind the screen to make the users dream, I've redirected my life to this domain! In this position, it's important to understand what are the needs of the people to create websites, software at their image. Are you interested into my services and visions ? Contact me! Whatever is your motivation like know me more, asking me questions, there is no risk !
philosophy: Through my scholarship and my professional life, I managed to be in multiples domains and master various langages and technologies. Today, I can conceive any kind of technical need from a website to a mobile application. A framework and a programming langage are only a way of speaking and items just like tools for a blacksmith. Understand and reach the need of a client, maximize product value, make it work and strong, this is my philosophy.
pointOne: It's always important to put in light what the final user wants from his/her application and how it should works.
pointTwo: If a client wants a website, it's logical to use technologies for this purpose! If he/her wants a mobile application, same logic.
pointThree: Everyone wants a final product; but before reaching the ending form, it's good to create a Minimal Version Product that works to have a strong base ! Improvements will come in a progressive way.
pointFour: Build an application is fantastic, but it's more satisfying when the tests give the respected results.
pointFive: We are in continuous learning during our life. We always gain new knowledge; even if we accept to develop a software for someone. This concept is persistent with improvement of the mastering of the used technology!
pointSix: Split the tasks; delegate some part of the work; order it to reach the final step; organization is a key to conceive with success any kind of application. Combined with a strong communication, client or teammates, the result can only be positive.

sopraDescription: These applications have been evolved during my professionnalisation contract for my last year of studies. The objective was they pass from VB.Net to C#.Net, with a better design, intuitive use.
hanoiDescription: When I wanted to gain a mission as a QML developer (C++ in back, javascript in front), I got challenged on my skills in face of a situation where I don't know the technology at all. The developer put some challenges and conditions to build this Hanoï Tower Game. Main challenge was a game working, with a timer, counting the time with 4 disks. There were other optionals steps. Without help except myself, looking on internet, the result was the game was completed, up to 8 disks, drag'n'drop working, challenge mode, a menu, animations when winning. One of my projects I'm proud and is a proof I can learn and realize good things when I don't know anything.
werewolfAngularTitle: Werewolves of Miller's Hollow utilities application from One Night/One Crepuscule
werewolfAngularDescription: Back in France, I was going to a board game bar where I played a lot the game of werewolves of Miller's Hollow. Since we were creating a lot of roles to match the game of Miller's Hollow (basic game), we had some hard time to remember. In order to improve my skills and learn a new technology, I created the application on Angular that allow to track the calls, roles alive, register informations like the lovers. Then, from a web application, this was deported to a mobile one through the 'capacitor' module that transforms angular application into mobile application.
werewolfKotlinTitle: Werewolves of Miller's Hollow utilities application
werewolfKotlinDescription: I did it again but from scratch in Kotlin this time, to learn new things and do better. This one was needed for my work as a free animator in a board game association I was going a lot and where I bring the culture of roleplaying. Since the host were giving me their full trust, and we were, with friends, handling with paper before a lot of informations, I decided to create again this application, but with the the cards of the original game, changing his aspect, handling better and logical turn and calls, informations, adding a creation role part in it. This application is another one I'm proud of. It is light in memory, fast, intuitive.
